<type name="net" category="libraryfunc" is="library">
	<summary>The net library is one of a number of ways to send data between the client and server. 

The major advantages of the net library are the large size limit (64kb/message) and the ability to send data backwards - from the client to the server.

Refer to <page>Net Library Usage</page> for a short introduction.</summary>
</type>
